notes.title: Release Time Update
notes.content:
Hello,

I would like to update everyone that the first early access version of the game will be released today (September 8, 2022) at 4pm PDT time.

You can still wishlist the game on -> https://store.steampowered.com/app/2102530/Mega_Fast_Food_A_Fast_Food_Simulator_Game
to get updated once I clicked the Release button.
